title: Fin-ally Supported: Shark-fin supports for long, flat, tilted overhangs. A hobbyist's field guide and a defensive publication
description: Shark-fin supports for FDM printing: thin plates that run downhill under a long, flat, tilted overhang, follow its slope, touch it only at small teeth (two anchor teeth at the low end), stop at 85 % of its height with a blunt flat top, and stand on a crossbar foot and a one-layer brim pad. The paper gives the method in rebuildable detail, the design history including its mistakes, slicer-estimated costs, a test plan, and in section 7 a defensive disclosure of the method and its variations, which are dedicated to the public. Nothing has been printed yet; all numbers come from code, slicer estimates and G-code. Software: https://github.com/The-Dorkknight/cura-shark-support
